parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: The logical ID of the entity.

parameters.name: EntityIdentity
parameters.description: The feature value of the entity. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Specify this parameter based on the regions in which your assets reside. Valid values:

*   cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in regions in China.
*   ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside in regions outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the account that you switch from the management account.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The type of the view. Valid values:
- 0: the current Alibaba Cloud account
- 1: the global account

parameters.name: SophonTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the SOAR handling policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem describe-entity-info --entity-id 12345 --entity-identity test22.php --incident-uuid 85ea4241-798f-4684-a876-65d4f0c30000 --sophon-task-id 577bbf90-a770-44a7-8154-586aa2d318fa --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
